status: native-legacy-Qoder-source/JSON-Bearer/Host scoped gate and exact featureless release passed; complete Qoder/P4 still open
classification: ADR131/map registered the A-level legacy credential/dialect/source contract before implementation. The model/encoder/transport wiring implements that contract, with permission, Evidence, Context admission, canonical persistence and unknown recovery unchanged. No UI flow changed.

implemented.dialect: The actual selected-model local catalog or nonempty persisted modelOptions selects prepared-infer. An absent selected model uses the old JSON/Bearer endpoint. Empty arrays remain an explicit override, null is undeclared. Invalid/known-future QMC or conflicting sources fail instead of silently switching dialect or token after an error. The runtime choice is derived from the bound account/config/catalog, with no new user-writable mode toggle.
implemented.credentials: QODER_ACCESS_TOKEN > QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN > QODER_PAT, JS-trimmed nonempty precedence. Winning env credentials never read the local user/machine files. Prepared mode still rejects env-only credentials as requiring user info. Legacy accepts the selected env token or the existing read-only decrypted local token; uid is only required for prepared mode, but present field types/size and expiry remain checked. No third-party login/refresh/writeback, Helper or VM fallback.
implemented.ownership: ReadSet centralizes existing/absent file observations for credentials/catalog/endpoint, retaining captured bounded reads, regular-file NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK/CLOEXEC and pre/post fd/path identity checks. Account owns one immutable dialect and captured environment/config identity. Per-send validation rejects stale source/config/dialect after logout/rotation/catalog appearance. Captured settings, local secret owner and endpoint selection have separate responsibilities. Only selected catalog metadata remains resident after construction.
implemented.request: Legacy builder reuses canonical history/tool pairing/assistant merge/schema transforms and emits raw frozen JSON, not the prepared-mode custom carrier. Metadata request/session IDs bind sensitive/protected X-Request-ID/X-Session-ID and Bearer headers;2MiB prepared-request limit and actual-byte fingerprint remain. Explicit baseUrl wins, otherwise existing model-host/prod/daily/test settings select a validated URL through the same Native Network. Inference endpoint settings never redirect the legacy route.
implemented.host: Both dialects use the same complete-stream tool intent -> Runtime Projection/PermissionGrant -> Provider -> ToolResult/Evidence/Store. Existing billing/known/unknown semantics are retained; the legacy receipt fingerprint is checked against actual HTTP bytes. No new execution loop or capability branch.
